WITH sorted_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state,
        LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (
            ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
        ) AS prev_city,
        LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (
            ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
        ) AS prev_lat,
        LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (
            ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
        ) AS prev_lng
    FROM olist_geolocation
)
SELECT 
    prev_city,
    geolocation_city,
    ROUND(6371 * ACOS(
        GREATEST(-1.0, LEAST(1.0, 
            COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(prev_lng - geolocation_lng)) + 
            SIN(RADIANS(geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(prev_lat))
        ))
    ), 2) AS distance_km
FROM sorted_cities
WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND prev_lng IS NOT NULL AND prev_city IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 5
